skills.name: 观微
skills.text: 每回合限一次，一名角色的出牌阶段结束后，若其本回合使用过至少两张牌且这些牌花色均相同，你可以弃置一张牌，令其摸两张牌并执行一个额外的出牌阶段。
notes: Launch: playEnding optional trigger with turnOwnerScope anyLiving (own and other living play ends) gated by the turn-owner used-suit history condition; usageScope turn with usageLimit 1 so both branches share one launch per turn.

Condition: the engine's per-turn card-use ledger (CurrentTurnCardUseKindsRecordedEvent) proves at least two uses by the current turn owner whose recorded hand-suit masks resolve to a single suit; a use whose physical cards do not all come from the owner's own hand records an empty suit mask and never satisfies the condition.
Cost: selectAndMoveOwnedCard (owner chooser, hand+equipment, 1 card, discard pile, skipIfNoCards) reusing the established discard-cost pattern; the movement carries the skill reason.

Grant: draw(selectedTarget, 2) plus insertPhase(selectedTarget, play, beforeNormalPreparation) — the same scheduled-phase mechanism as 廖化当先, extended so a playEnding grant can name the current turn player as beneficiary; the inserted phase runs inside the beneficiary's own turn and the scheduling fact is public.

skills.name: 公清
skills.text: 锁定技，当你受到伤害时，若伤害来源的攻击范围：小于3，将此次伤害的伤害值改为1；大于3，此伤害+1。
notes: Locked passive expressed declaratively through two damageModifiers on the owner: damageSourceAttackRangeBelowThree with capsToAmount (joins the silver-lion maximum slot in FinalizeAttackDamageAmount) and damageSourceAttackRangeAboveThree adding +1 through the existing additive modifier pipeline.
sourceScope damageParticipant: the modifier is read from the damage target's program instances; the exact-three boundary falls through both conditions and stays untouched.
A cap that actually reduces damage emits ProgramDamageCappedEvent (base amount, capped amount, skill source) for public evidence; boosts keep the existing ProgramCardDamageModifiedEvent.

observations: OL lists 潘濬 as wu 3HP male with title 方严疾恶 (星火燎原-天机); the biligame texts for 观微/公清 are the current OL wording and match the implemented presentation verbatim.

No new bespoke ops were needed (the pre-allocated 7188-7195 range stays unused); no new player markers. Shared capability extensions: playEnding turnOwnerScope anyLiving; ScheduleProgramPhase play-ending beneficiary grant; insertPhase selectedTarget; TurnOwnerUsedSameSuitCards trigger condition + fact; damageModifiers capsToAmount plus the two attack-range conditions and ProgramDamageCappedEvent.
观微's same-suit condition reads only proactively-used cards whose physical cards all come from the owner's own hand; converted or sourceless uses never satisfy it.
公清 only rewrites damage that has a damage source (attacker attack range); sourceless damage is untouched, and an exact range of three is neither capped nor boosted.

An unpayable 观微 launch cannot arise in practice (arming two same-suit uses always leaves payable cards in hand), so the cost keeps the established skipIfNoCards fallback (ol-deng-zhong precedent) instead of a new offer gate.
